claims.quote: Money is the alignment signal for agents.
PayBox got crypto traders onto Claude and ChatGPT — agentic surfaces, not an xAI partnership.
LayerZero moved $10B cross-chain in 30 days at 89.73% market share.
Tokenization should fund data centers and factories.
The blockchain doesn't have an undo button. In a bank, you have recall procedures, reconciliation, a settlement desk. On chain, none of this exists.
People are letting an LLM review their own transactions, and I'm heavily pushing against it — one probabilistic process auditing another.
We've run more than 4 billion simulations over the past eight years against blockchain state.
Agent Card spends anywhere cards are accepted; Agent Pay / x402 is onchain HTTP 402 — pick the rail for the job.
